# Shodh Sagar Journal of Inspiration and Psychology

> A peer-reviewed open access academic journal publishing research in psychology and inspiration through double-blind peer review and OJS-based publishing infrastructure.

Shodh Sagar Journal of Inspiration and Psychology is an open access, peer-reviewed academic journal managed by Shodh Sagar organization. The journal uses OJS/PKP publishing system and maintains rigorous academic standards including plagiarism detection, archiving policies, and transparent peer review processes.
